notes.title: Changes to difficulty modes.
notes.content:
Normal difficulty mode now has 3 lives instead of one.
There are now 3 difficulty modes:
- Normal: 3 lives / level.
- Hard: 1 life / level.
- Hardest: 1 life / level, and various changes (some levels are longer and includes more and larger obstacles).
Small UI-fixes.
Small in-game fixes.
